This policy explains how SMEmarket collects, uses, shares and protects personal data when you use www.smemarket.ae (the "Site"), whether you are looking at businesses for sale, listing your own, finding a provider in our directory, or asking about our services. It is written to meet the UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data (the "PDPL").
SMEmarket is operated by SME Market L.L.C-FZ, a limited liability company formed and licensed in the Meydan Free Zone, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
Licence number: 2654774.01 (formation number 2654774), issued under the Meydan Free Zone regulations
Registered address: Meydan Grandstand, 6th floor, Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba, Dubai, UAE

For the purposes of the PDPL, SME Market L.L.C-FZ is the controller of the personal data described in this policy. Article 10 of the PDPL requires a Data Protection Officer only for high-risk processing (because of new technology or the volume of data), for systematic evaluation of sensitive personal data, or for large volumes of sensitive personal data, with the thresholds to be set by the Executive Regulations, which have not yet been issued. Our processing is small in scale and does not involve sensitive personal data, so we have not appointed a formal DPO. Our privacy contact is admin@smemarket.ae. If the Executive Regulations require us to appoint a DPO, we will do so and publish their contact details here.
Because we are licensed in the Meydan Free Zone (not the DIFC or ADGM), the federal PDPL is the data protection law that applies to us. The DIFC and ADGM data protection laws do not apply.
You don't need an account to use the Site. We only collect what you choose to send us: the details you put in a form, or a message on WhatsApp.

Buyers ask us about a listing; sellers send us their business details. We handle every enquiry ourselves and only share a seller's business name or a buyer's details with the other side after speaking to them.
We do not ask for ID documents, and we do not use AI to make decisions about you.
We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
We use a small number of service providers (Cloudflare, Web3Forms, Google and, if you choose it, WhatsApp), some of which process data outside the UAE.
You can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data at any time by emailing admin@smemarket.ae.
Enquiries about a business for sale
When you ask about a listing we collect your name, phone or WhatsApp number, email address (optional), company name (optional), your question, and which listing you asked about.

If you list a business we collect your name, phone or WhatsApp number, email address (optional), the business name (optional), and your answers about the business: industry, emirate and area, asking price, revenue, profit and a short description. The business name and your contact details are seen only by our team; the public listing shows the industry, area, figures and description.

When you search the directory, the words you type and the area you pick are sent from our server to a public business-data service to find matching businesses (see section 6). We do not send your name or any other personal details with the search, and searches are cached for one day without any link to you. If you ask to add your company to our partner list, we collect your name, company, category, area, website, phone and email.

When you use any other form on the Site we collect what you enter: your name, phone or WhatsApp number, email address (optional), company name (optional), the topics you pick and your message, plus the page you sent it from.
If you email us, call us or message us on WhatsApp, we receive your name, number or email address and what you send.
Like any website, our hosting provider receives your IP address and browser details when you visit, and uses them to keep the Site secure. We do not use analytics or tracking tools.
Only SMEmarket staff have accounts on the Site. For them we store a name, email address and a salted hash of their password, never the password itself.

Our providers store and process data outside the UAE, mainly in the United States and Europe, and Cloudflare caches data in its data centres worldwide. The PDPL allows this. Article 22 allows transfers to countries with adequate data protection laws (for example the EU member states, which have the GDPR). Where a country does not have adequate protection, Article 23 allows the transfer on other grounds, including where it is necessary to perform a contract with you and where the recipient is bound by a contract that protects the data. We rely on:
necessity for our contract with you, or for steps you ask us to take: we cannot host the Site or reply to you without these providers;

contractual safeguards: each provider's data processing terms bind it to process data only on our instructions, keep it confidential and secure, and use sub-processors only under equivalent terms. Cloudflare and Google also offer the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
When the PDPL Executive Regulations set more detailed transfer rules, we will follow them and update this section.

No system is completely secure. If a personal data breach affects your privacy, confidentiality or security, we will notify the UAE Data Office (or the authority that takes over its role) and tell you, as required by Article 9 of the PDPL, and explain what we are doing about it.
Under the PDPL (Articles 13 to 18) you have the right to:
Information and access: know what personal data we hold about you, why, who we share it with (inside and outside the UAE), how long we keep it, and how it is protected, free of charge.
Portability: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Correction: have inaccurate data corrected or incomplete data completed.
Erasure: have your data deleted when it is no longer needed, when you withdraw consent, or when it was processed unlawfully. We may keep some data where the law requires it or to defend legal claims.
Restriction: ask us to limit how we use your data, for example while we check its accuracy.
Stop processing: ask us to stop processing, including for direct marketing.
Object to automated decisions: object to decisions made only by automated processing that affect you, and ask for a person to review them.

To use any of these rights, email admin@smemarket.ae. We may ask you to confirm your identity. We will reply within 30 days of receiving your request. If the PDPL Executive Regulations set a shorter period, we will follow it.
If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, please contact us first. You can also complain to the UAE Data Office (or the authority that takes over its role).
